messages:
Alex: Hey folks — I'm ramping up this week. I need access to two GCP projects (dev-redwood, eu-data-prod) and to assume an AWS cross-account role in prod-data to run the integration job. Also need billing-view on the billing account redwood-eu-billing and APAC region quotas enabled. I tried opening eu-data-prod and got a 403. Who should I ping and what exact info do you need?

Maria: @Alex welcome! For GCP please paste the project IDs (not names) and the email you want added. For AWS we need the account ID and the role ARN. Billing access is handled by infra/finance so I'll route that once I have the billing account ID.

Maria: Typical roles we add for onboarding: `roles/viewer` or `roles/browser` for project read, `roles/iam.serviceAccountUser` if you need to impersonate SA, and `roles/billing.viewer` for billing. If you're hitting 403 it may be org-policy restricting locations or folder-level permissions.

Alex: Project IDs: `dev-redwood-123`, `eu-data-prod-77`. AWS account id: `999888777666`, role: `arn:aws:iam::999888777666:role/RedwoodReadOnlyCrossAccount`. Billing account id: `01A2B3-C4D5E6-7890F1`.

Maria: Thanks. Can you run these two quick checks and paste the output?

```
gcloud projects get-iam-policy eu-data-prod-77 --format=json | jq '.bindings[] | select(.role=="roles/owner" or .role=="roles/editor")'

gcloud organizations get-iam-policy YOUR_ORG_ID --flatten="bindings" --format='table(bindings.role, bindings.members)'
```

Maria: Also, if you see an org policy `constraints/resourceLocations` that could explain region/quota issues — I'll check the folder policies.

Alex: Pasted outputs (redacted): bindings show folder:europe-team as owner, no direct editor for my user. Org policy shows `constraints/restrictResourceLocations` set to `[europe-west1, europe-west4]`.

Jordan: Hey @Maria / @Alex — I own the eu folder. The eu-data-prod project sits under a folder with restrictResourceLocations set to europe-west1 and europe-west4 only. APAC regions are blocked at the org level for that folder. If Alex needs APAC compute/GKE we either whitelist additional regions or create a separate project under a different folder. Which do you need?

Alex: I only need to run a short integration in asia-southeast1 (APAC) for a partner test next Tues. Can we get a temporary exception?

Jordan: I can do a temporary exemption via group `onboard-temp` and add `asia-southeast1` to the project's allowed locations for 72 hours. But billing viewer needs finance approval; I'll open a billing request and tag @finance.

Sam: Also, for AWS assume-role quick test you can run: 

```
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::999888777666:role/RedwoodReadOnlyCrossAccount --role-session-name alex-onboard-test
```

Sam: And set CLI default regions: `gcloud config set compute/region europe-west1` and `aws configure set default.region eu-west-1` (or `ap-southeast-1` for APAC).

Maria: I've opened ticket #CLOUD-8421 for the billing viewer request and linked the project/org policy details. @cloud-ops-bot can you create a temp access group and notify when done?

cloud-ops-bot: Ticket CLOUD-8421 created and assigned to infra-billing. Temporary group `onboard-temp` will be created after approval. ETA ~2 business days. :robot_face:

Alex: Amazing — thank you all. If Jordan can add `asia-southeast1` for 72h that should let the partner run their test. I'll share any error logs here if anything else pops up.

Jordan: Done — added `asia-southeast1` to allowed locations for project `eu-data-prod-77` for 72 hours and added you to `onboard-temp`. You should be able to create resources in that region now. Let me know if you still see 403s.

Alex: I can create a small VM in asia-southeast1 now. Tests starting. :party_parrot:
